_comment: Source registry. permitted_use is set by a human after reading robots.txt
and the publisher's terms; the collector refuses to fetch anything that is
not 'feed'. This mirrors the `sources` table in 0001_directory.sql.
Reviewed 2026-08-12 by fetching each robots.txt directly.

excluded.name: SCOTUSblog
excluded.reason: robots.txt explicitly disallows ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, Bytespider and other AI crawlers. The feed responds, but the publisher has signalled it does not consent to AI collection. Excluded.

excluded.name: Korean Lawyers Association Times (lawtimes.co.kr)
excluded.reason: Returns HTTP 403 to identified bot traffic. Treated as refusal; approach the publisher for a licence rather than working around the block.

excluded.name: Law Society Gazette
excluded.reason: Feed URL returns 404. A valid feed may exist elsewhere on the site; not yet located.

excluded.name: Law.asia
excluded.reason: Direct competitor. Technically open — sitemap serves, no AI-crawler rules — and deliberately excluded anyway. Systematically ingesting a rival directory's archive is the exact 'selection and arrangement' that compilation and database-right claims protect, and the accusation alone would destroy the source-transparency this publication is built on. Licence, do not crawl.

excluded.name: Asian Legal Business (legalbusinessonline.com)
excluded.reason: Returns HTTP 403 to identified bot traffic. Treated as refusal, same posture as lawtimes.co.kr.

excluded.name: Global Legal Post
excluded.reason: robots.txt carries 5 AI-crawler directives; not yet read line by line. Held pending review rather than admitted on a passing check.
